home.title: Enter The Quantum Quest.
home.intro: A text adventure you play over an HTTP API. Explore rooms, pick up items, solve puzzles and escape each level in as few actions as possible: type commands in the web terminal, or write a script — or an AI agent — that plays for you.
home.browserText: A web terminal for every level, with command history.
home.apiText: Same game, plain JSON over HTTP. Perfect for scripts and AI agents.
home.whatIsText: A text adventure (or interactive fiction) is a game where everything happens through text. The game describes where you are and what you see; you answer with short commands like look, take lamp or go north. In The Quantum Quest each of those commands is also an API call, so you can play by hand or automate your way through.

about.title: About The Quantum Quest
about.intro: A gamified challenge platform built around a classic idea: the text adventure, reimagined as an API.
about.missionText: Make exploring APIs, scripting and agent design feel like a game — because it is one.
about.agentsText: Every level can be played by hand in the browser or by a program talking to the same HTTP API.
about.openText: A documented OpenAPI spec, plain JSON and API keys: no SDK required.
about.step2: Pick a level in Level Select. Levels unlock one after another.
about.step3: Play it in the web terminal, or generate an API key and play with curl, a script or an AI agent.
about.step4: Finish in fewer actions for a higher score, and climb the event leaderboards.
about.creatorsText: The Quantum Quest is an open-source project created by Baptiste Pirault and released under the MIT licence. Found a bug in the simulation or have an idea for a level? <issues>Open an issue</issues> on the <repo>GitHub repository</repo>.
about.inspirationText: Inspired by <game>The Temple of the Forgotten Prompt</game> by <author>Wietse Venema</author>.

gameApi.title: API Access
gameApi.subtitle: Play the game from curl, a script or an AI agent.
gameApi.newKeyWarning: Copy this key now: it will not be shown again. Treat it like a password; anyone with it can play as you.
gameApi.prefixHelp: For security, only the beginning of your key is shown. Regenerate it if you lost it.
gameApi.noKey: You don't have an API key yet.
gameApi.regeneratePrompt: This revokes your current key immediately. Continue?
gameApi.quickStartNote: Start a level from Level Select first. The API always acts on your active level (the one you last started or resumed), the same one as the web terminal. Without one, game calls answer 409 no_active_level.
gameApi.languageNote: Game texts are in English. Add ?lang=fr to a call (or send Accept-Language: fr) to get them in French. Commands, exit names and error codes stay in English; item names work in both languages.
gameApi.errorsNote: Errors are JSON: { "error", "message" } with status 400 (unknown target, locked exit…), 401 (bad key), 409 (no active level) or 429 (rate limited).

endpoint.look: Describe the current room: name, description, items, exits.
endpoint.examine: Examine an item, feature or exit.
endpoint.move: Go through an exit. Returns the new room, or { message, score } when the level is completed.
endpoint.take: Take an item from the room.
endpoint.drop: Drop an item from your inventory.
endpoint.use: Use a thing, or two things on each other.

gameApi.specText: Every request and response schema, in OpenAPI format. Feed it to your agent.
